reason: Source S1 (the changed source flagged by the event) redirects its current-status to record W ("Current-status pointer: W"). The allocated record RZ contained no decision evidence. With both record-read slots consumed (RZ via allocation, S1 via the remaining read), record W — which holds the actual constraint status — could not be inspected. Therefore the constraint can be neither confirmed valid/withdrawn nor dispositioned as apply/do_not_apply. An additional read of record W is required to complete verification.
